headline: Character Hub, from entry to detail
overview: Central hub for all character and identity tools, providing a unified view of your personality assessments, strengths, and self-discovery journey.
targetAudience: Users interested in growth tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Unified hub for all character and identity tools
Track progress across multiple personality assessments
Navigate easily between interconnected self-discovery tools
See a holistic view of your character development journey
tips: Start with the foundational assessments like MBTI or Big Five before exploring deeper tools.
Return to the Character Hub regularly to see how your completed assessments connect.
